agent_explanation: Controller commands approximately kp * velocity-error (plus seeded sensor noise) without clamping to fmax. At step 0 body has large velocity error (vy=-5.85 vs commanded velocity toward waypoint (12.1,8.8) at vcmd=5.39). With kp=26.4 this yields force ~250.3 > fmax 194.58 at step 1. Lowering kp alone removes the violation, confirming unclamped proportional gain as cause.
